title: A little room to talk
subtitle: Three conversation worksheets for adult couples
intro: Write privately first. Share only what you choose. You can pause, skip a question, or come back later. These pages support a conversation; they do not ask you to reach an agreement or act on an answer.

sheets.title: Couple intimacy check-in
sheets.purpose: Notice how things feel right now, without needing to fix or decide anything immediately.
questions: How I feel about our intimacy lately
What feels good or supportive right now
What feels a bit off, missing, or unclear
My current level of openness
Open and curious / Neutral or unsure / Closed or tired / I don’t know yet
What I’d like more of (not a demand)
What I’d like less of (or a pause from)
One small thing that would help right now
sheets.note: This check-in is about noticing and sharing, not negotiating or solving everything at once.

sheets.title: Desire alignment
sheets.purpose: Identify where desires overlap, differ, or leave room for curiosity, without pressure to act or agree.
questions: Desires I feel clear about right now
Desires I feel unsure or curious about
Desires that don’t feel right for me at the moment
What “Maybe” means for me today
More information / More time / Depends on context / Depends on the approach / Open to talking, not doing
What helps me feel aligned with my partner
What makes alignment harder for me
One question I’d like to explore together
sheets.note: A Maybe is an opening for conversation, not consent to an activity. A No does not need an explanation.

sheets.title: Before talking about desire
sheets.purpose: Clarify your thoughts before starting a sensitive conversation.
questions: What I hope for from this conversation
What feels a little scary for me
What I need to feel safe
Calm tone / Permission to pause / No immediate decisions / Privacy / Reassurance
The simple sentence I want to say
What I am not asking for
If the conversation becomes difficult
Take a break / Postpone / Switch to writing / Change the subject
Closing sentence
sheets.note: Keep this page for yourself if you prefer. You choose which thoughts to share.
